title: Correct linear velocity
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be v₀ = √(GM / r₀).

title: Zero pressure justification
description: Important: The reasoning for part (2) must correctly apply Newton's second law to the astronaut in orbit, showing the net force is zero.

title: Work-energy theorem application
description: Important: For part (3), the solution must set up the work-energy theorem: W_engine + W_gravity = ΔKE.

title: Gravitational work calculation
description: Important: The work done by gravity, W_gravity, must be correctly calculated as GMm₀(1/r₀ - 1/r₁).

title: Velocity at reduced radius
description: Important: The kinetic energy at radius r₁ must be derived from Newton's law and centripetal force: v₁ = √(GM / r₁).

title: Final work expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must be W_min = (GMm₀/2)(1/r₁ - 1/r₀).

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the sign of the gravitational work or the final engine work is reversed, indicating a misunderstanding of energy increase.

title: Orbital force misconception
description: Pitfall: Penalize if part (2) incorrectly claims a non-zero normal force, confusing orbital free-fall with a supporting force.
